confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors broadly agree across several sources, but the sources are thin and partly unofficial: menu prices mostly come from one tourism guide, coffee and beer figures from user-reported cost-of-living data, and cocktail and wine from Andalusian and other Spanish city benchmarks. Cocktail is set at about 3.5 times the beer price, and wine is an inferred restaurant glass price. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July from general knowledge; no accommodation search or listing was inspected. EUR prices were converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.15 USD per EUR, which is not a sourced observation. The FX source is the most recent RBA exchange-rates page snapshot I could retrieve, dated 2026-03-20. A later RBA observation was not verified, so the rate may be several months old.
comparable_city_reasoning: Córdoba is treated as a mid-sized Andalusian city. Food and drink anchors use Andalusian city cocktail benchmarks (Granada, Cádiz, Almería), Spanish national menú del día averages, and Spanish wine-by-the-glass guidance, with Madrid and Barcelona treated as higher-priced. Accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of mid-sized Spanish cities in July.
